question: Which plan is our workspace on, and can we use SSO?

model.source: recorded from openai/gpt-oss-120b through the openai provider

replies.text: Your workspace Kitewood Studio is on the **Business plan** (annual billing). Since you use Okta as your identity provider, the workspace is set up for SSO, so members sign in with “Sign in with SSO” rather than a password [help:sign-in@6#3].
